intro: Lesson 100: Writing the change: the mountain wakes. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Short sentence: Then the ground shivered.
Sound: A deep rumble rolled across the bay.
Sight: Above Vesuvius, a cloud rose like a giant pine tree.
Reaction: Livia gripped the basket. Her heart thudded.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A paragraph where the tone changes

panels.title: Respectful writing
points: Show fear through the senses and actions
End the paragraph with action: the family decides to leave

keywords.def: a feeling that something is about to happen
a sentence of a few words that grabs attention
a hint about what will happen later

questions.q: Upgrade to tense: The mountain made a noise.
Add a reaction: The cloud grew.
questions.a: For example: The cloud grew. Livia froze.

questions.q: Core: write two paragraphs where the tone changes: the first sign, then the cloud and the decision to leave
questions.a: Two paragraphs with a clear change in tone

questions.q: Extend: use two powerful words from Pliny
questions.a: For example: engulfed, blacker than any night

questions.q: Stretch: use a rhetorical question in a character's thoughts
questions.a: For example: Was this the end of their town?

questions.q: Which sentence builds the most tension?
options: It was a nice day in the town.
questions.a: A) Then everything went quiet.. A sudden silence makes readers wait for something to happen.
